author: Wzyss
install_msg: Thank you for installing ChannelBackup! Use `[p]help channelbackup` to see commands. Requires Manage Channels (or admin).
name: ChannelBackup
short: Backup and restore channel structure, settings, and permissions.
description: Creates named backups of a guild's categories, text channels, voice channels, stage channels, and forums — including per-channel and per-category permission overwrites. Restore updates existing channels by ID (and optionally recreates missing ones) without deleting channels that are not in the backup.
